headline: Workshop on Complete Streets design guidelines and public hearing on major site plan amendment at 64 Pine Street.
summary: The Planning Board will hold a workshop on amendments to the City of Portland Technical Manual and a draft Complete Streets Design Guide. The board will also consider a major site plan amendment at 64 Pine Street that would increase residential units from nine to twelve and modify commercial space and parking.

PUBLIC COMMENT INFORMATION: 
To submit written public comment on an agenda item, email planningboard@portlandmaine.gov. Submissions 
must be received by 12:00 pm the day before the Planning Board meeting to guarantee their inclusion in the 
agenda packet. All submissions must include the commenter's name and legal address. To help ensure your 
comment is submitted for the correct item, please include the name of the agenda item (see below). 
 
 
AGENDA: 
 
    
WORKSHOP - 4:30 PM 
    
i. Technical Manual and Complete Streets Design Guidelines; City of Portland, Applicant.  The Planning 
Board will hold a hybrid workshop to consider amendments to Section 1 of the City of Portland 
Technical Manual, to implement the City of Portland's adopted Complete Streets Policy.  The Board 
will also consider a draft version of the City's Complete Streets Design Guide.  More information will 
be posted to the City's agenda center under this item. 
    
PUBLIC HEARING - 5:00 PM 
    
1. ROLL CALL AND DECLARATION OF QUORUM 
2. COMMUNICATION AND REPORTS 
3. REPORT OF ATTENDANCE AT THE MEETING HELD ON SEPTEMBER 22, 2026 
  Workshop 
105 Winter Street: Din, Messina, Robertson, Silk, Smith, Uhlenhake, and Zamboni present.  
92 Cassidy Point Drive: Din, Messina, Robertson, Silk, Smith, Uhlenhake, and Zamboni present.   
4. REPORTS OF DECISIONS AT THE MEETING HELD ON SEPTEMBER 22, 2026 
  i. There were no public hearing items on the agenda to report on. 
5. NEW BUSINESS 
  i. Major Site Plan Amendment; 64 Pine Street; 64 Pine Street, LLC., Applicant.  The Planning 
Board will consider a major site plan amendment to a previously approved major site plan 
application (PL-002678-2023) at 64 Pine Street.  The proposal would increase the number of 
residential units from nine to twelve, modify the commercial space and parking area, and 
update site improvements.  The property is located within the B-1 Neighborhood Business 
Zone.  A project and plan summary are available for viewing on the city's CSS Portal 
(https://css.portlandmaine.gov/) by referencing Plan Number PL-003677-2026.
